SkillSpector-fix (8 findings): LP3 permissions deklareret; Missing User Warnings (destruktiv deploy + Telegram-secrets) tilføjet i description/SKILL.md; sudo/nohup/setsid dokumenteret som bevidst adfærd; notify.sh credential-advarsel (chmod 600); deploy.sh advarselsheader

Initial version of deployment-kit: deploy and manage VPS services with robust monitoring and alerts.

- One-command deploy: build, restart, verify
- Automated process management with systemd units and cron @reboot
- Nginx reverse-proxy template for domain routing
- Watchdog checks service heartbeat, restarts on failure, and sends Telegram alerts
- Includes templates and best practices from production use
